concepts.label: REST resources
concepts.description: REST-style APIs organize operations around resource representations and HTTP semantics.

concepts.label: gRPC contracts
concepts.description: gRPC generally uses Protocol Buffers service definitions for typed RPC interfaces.

concepts.label: OpenAPI specification
concepts.description: OpenAPI describes HTTP API paths, parameters, operations, schemas, and responses.

concepts.label: Idempotent operations
concepts.description: Repeated calls should have the same intended effect as one call under an idempotent contract.

concepts.label: Retry policy
concepts.description: Retry logic requires backoff and bounded attempts, and must respect operation idempotency.

concepts.label: Circuit breaker
concepts.description: Circuit breakers stop repeatedly calling a dependency that is failing.

concepts.label: Eventual consistency
concepts.description: Replicated state may converge after a delay rather than being immediately consistent.

concepts.label: CQRS
concepts.description: Command Query Responsibility Segregation separates write-command and read-query responsibilities.

concepts.label: Event sourcing
concepts.description: Event sourcing derives state from a log of recorded domain events.

concepts.label: Saga transactions
concepts.description: A saga coordinates multi-step operations through local transactions and compensating actions.

concepts.label: Kafka event streams
concepts.description: Kafka organizes records by topics and partitions for ordered consumption within partitions.

concepts.label: Redis cache
concepts.description: Redis can act as an in-memory key-value store and caching layer.

concepts.label: Kubernetes workload
concepts.description: Pods and controllers reconcile declarative desired state for container workloads.

concepts.label: Terraform state
concepts.description: Terraform tracks managed resources and desired configurations using providers and state.

concepts.label: Docker container
concepts.description: Container images package application files and runtime requirements for process isolation.

concepts.label: AWS IAM authorization
concepts.description: IAM policies define allowed and denied actions on AWS resources for principals.

concepts.label: AWS VPC networking
concepts.description: VPC subnets, routing and network controls define isolation and reachability.

concepts.label: AWS Lambda functions
concepts.description: Lambda executes serverless function handlers triggered by requests or events.

concepts.label: Distributed tracing
concepts.description: Distributed traces follow requests across services with trace and span identifiers.

concepts.label: Service metrics
concepts.description: Metrics record numerical operational measurements such as latency, errors, and traffic.
